summary.content:
Today's selection covers 87 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 54 on Artificial Intelligence and 21 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Grammarly says it will stop using AI to clone experts without permission
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Are A.I.-Generated Videos Changing How We See Animals?
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
